title: Evidence
description: The evidence of a change over the range of commits from `base` to `head`: what no covering check read, the intent, the rules that failed, warned, and held, the size, the work items, and the route.

install.description: The path of the install from the git top level; `.` for a top-level install.

base.description: The full sha of the commit that `--base` names, or the name of git's empty tree for a range from the start of the history.

head.description: The full sha of the head commit of the range.

merge_base.description: The full sha of the merge base of `base` and `head`; `null` for a range from the empty tree.

intent.description: The intents of the change, in the order of the adapters, then by `ref`. A named intent that does not resolve is an entry with its `source` and `ref`, `null` for every other field of the contract (`artifacts` is empty), and the key `unresolved`: the line of its adapter. An intent that resolves carries no `unresolved` key.

rules.description: The rule package that judged the change.

uncovered.description: The part of the change that no covering check read.

failed.description: The deterministic rules with the result `fail`, sorted by id. A booked fail keeps the text `(sanctioned: <ref>)` in its evidence.

warned.description: The deterministic rules with the result `warn`, sorted by id.

proven.description: The deterministic rules with the result `pass`, sorted by id.

judged.description: The rules that have no check, sorted by id, each with the verdict of the review file.

skipped.description: The deterministic rules with the result `skipped`: the checks that did not apply to the change, sorted by id.

work_items.description: The `Work-Item` ids of the range, sorted.

route.description: The route decision for the same range.

Intent.description: What one adapter found about the intent of a change. A field that the adapter cannot fill is `null`; the keys come in this order. A named intent that does not resolve is an entry with its `source` and `ref`, every other field `null` (`artifacts` empty), and the key `unresolved`.

source.description: The name of the adapter, such as `work-item` or `file`.

ref.description: The id that the adapter gives the intent: a work-item id, a folder, or a path.

tasks.description: The counts of the task list, or `null`.

requirements.description: The counts of the requirements, or `null`.

validation.description: The result of a spec tool's validation, or `null`.

artifacts.description: The paths that the adapter read.

unresolved.description: The line of the adapter for a named intent that does not resolve. The key is absent for an intent that resolves.

Tasks.description: The counts of a task list.

Requirements.description: The counts of the requirements that a change adds, edits, removes, and renames. A count that the source does not give is `null`.

added.description: The requirements that the change adds, or `null`.

modified.description: The requirements that the change modifies, or `null`.

removed.description: The requirements that the change removes, or `null`.

renamed.description: The requirements that the change renames, or `null`.

Validation.description: The result of a spec tool's validation, read from a file that a caller passes; no adapter runs the tool.

ok.description: Whether the tool judged the spec valid.

Rules.description: The rule package that judged a change: the hashes of its sources at the two ends of the range and the packs that the install pins at the head.

merge_base_hash.description: The SHA-256 of the rule sources at the merge base; `null` when the merge base holds none.

head_hash.description: The SHA-256 of the rule sources at the head.

packs.description: The packs that the marker of the install pins at the head, read from git, sorted by name.

PackPin.description: A knowledge pack that the install pins.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the copy of the pack in the install.

Diff.description: The size of the diff of the range, without the paths that `review.diffExclude` leaves out.

Uncovered.description: The part of a change that no covering check read: a path is covered when a check that declares `covers: true` read it and its row passed or warned.

lines.description: The changed lines of the uncovered paths.

total_lines.description: The changed lines of all paths.

share.description: `lines` over `total_lines`, from 0 to 1; 0 when there is no changed line.

paths.description: The uncovered paths, sorted by path.

UncoveredPath.description: A changed path that no covering check read: the element of the `uncovered.paths` list of the evidence document (spec 5.9).

path.description: The path from the install root. A deleted path is its old path.

old_path.description: The path before a rename, or `null`.

ranges.description: The lines that the hunks of the path touch, in the order of the diff.

empty.description: For the kind `empty` only: whether the range adds or deletes the file. The key is absent for every other kind.

ChangeKind.description: What happened to one changed path. The change analysis gives each path one kind (spec 4.2). Serialized, a kind is its lower-case name.

oneOf.description: Added or edited text: the path has hunks.
A deleted file that held lines.
A rename with no edit: the path has no hunk.
An empty file that was added or deleted.
A binary file.
A change of the file mode only.
A symbolic link (mode `120000`).
A submodule (mode `160000`).

LineRange.description: The lines that one hunk of a changed path touches. Serialized, a range is one of two objects: `{"start": s, "end": e}` or `{"after": n, "deleted": k}`.

anyOf.description: The lines `start` to `end` of the file, counted from 1. For a deleted file they are the lines of the old file.
A hunk that only deletes lines: `deleted` lines went away after line `after` of the new file. `after` is 0 when the deletion is at the top.

after.description: The line of the new file after which the lines went away.

deleted.description: The number of lines that went away.

EmptyChange.description: Whether an empty file was added or deleted. An empty file has no hunk and no rename, so its kind alone does not tell the two apart. Serialized, it is its lower-case name.

oneOf.description: The range adds the empty file.
The range deletes the empty file.

RuleRow.description: The row of a deterministic rule.

id.description: The id of the knowledge entry.

evidence.description: What the check found, as the audit result gives it.

JudgedRow.description: The row of a rule that has no check, with the verdict of the review file.

id.description: The id of the knowledge entry.

verdict.description: The result of the `rule_adherence` row of the review file for the id, or `open` for any result other than `pass`, `fail`, and `warn`. `null` when there is no review file or it has no row for the id.

evidence.description: The evidence of that row; `null` when there is no row or it has none.

Verdict.description: The verdict of a review on a judged rule.

oneOf.description: The review found the rule kept.
The review found the rule broken.
The review found a fault that fails nothing.
The review gave no verdict: its row was skipped or holds another result.

RouteDocument.title: Route decision
RouteDocument.description: The decision of `houserules route` for a range of commits: the route, the inputs that the rules read, and a reason for each rule that was evaluated.

install.description: The path of the install from the git top level; `.` for a top-level install.

head.description: The full sha of the head commit of the range.

route.description: The route of the change: the highest route of the reasons.

floor.description: `true` for the tool-free floor that `--no-audit` computes. The floor reads no audit row, so it has no failed or warned row and no uncovered share.

inputs.description: What the rules read. Every input appears whether or not it raised the route.

reasons.description: One reason for each rule of spec 6.2 that was evaluated, one that found nothing included, and one for each limit or threshold that the change stays within. A rule that found nothing has one reason with the value 0 at the route `auto-merge-eligible`. A floor reads no audit row, so it has no reason for failed rows and warned rows. The score has reasons only with a `--score`, and the default route only for a change with no changed path and no changed rule source. They come in the order of the rules: rule sources, failed rows, warned rows, areas, paths in no area, path entries, score, default.

Route.description: How closely a change gets reviewed. The variants are ordered from the lowest route to the highest, so `Ord` picks the stricter of two routes. Serialized, a route is its kebab-case name.

oneOf.description: No review is required before the change merges.
The project owner reviews the change.
A senior reviewer reviews the change.

Inputs.description: The inputs of a route decision.

failed.description: The ids of the deterministic rows with the result `fail` that no `--sanctioned` booking accepted, sorted. Empty in a floor.

warned.description: The ids of the deterministic rows with the result `warn`, sorted. Empty in a floor.

areas.description: The areas that hold a changed path, sorted by name, each with its changed paths. A deleted path counts by its old path, and a renamed path by both.

no_area.description: The changed paths, old paths included, that match no area, sorted.

paths.description: The entries of `review.route.paths` whose glob matches a changed path, in the order of the configuration.

diff_lines.description: The lines added and deleted, without the paths that `review.diffExclude` leaves out.

uncovered_share.description: The share of the changed lines that no covering check read, from 0 to 1; `null` in a floor.

rule_sources_changed.description: The changed rule sources, sorted: paths of the install's `knowledge/` folder and `.houserules.json` from the install root, and CI files from the git top level.

PathInput.description: One entry of `review.route.paths` that matches a changed path.

paths.description: The changed paths that the glob matches, old paths included, sorted.

Reason.description: One reason of a route decision: what a rule read and the route that it gave. A rule that found nothing, and a limit or a threshold that the change stays within, give `auto-merge-eligible`, the lowest route.

rule.description: The rule that the reason belongs to.

input.description: What the rule read: the id of a row, the name of an area, a glob, or the key of `inputs` for the other rules and for a rule that found nothing.

value.description: The value that the rule compared with its limit or threshold, or the number of paths of a rule that names paths, 0 for a rule that found nothing; `null` for a rule with none of these.

threshold.description: The limit or the threshold, or `null` for a rule that has none.

route.description: The route that the rule gave.

paths.description: The first 20 paths of a rule that names paths, sorted.

more_paths.description: The number of paths beyond the 20 of `paths`.

decisive.description: `true` for a reason at the final route.

ReasonRule.description: The rule that a reason belongs to. A rule with a limit has one reason for its route and one for each limit. A rule that found nothing has one reason that counts 0.

oneOf.description: A rule source changed: the knowledge folder, the marker of the install, or a CI file of the project.
A deterministic row failed and no booking accepted it.
A deterministic row warned.
The route of an area that holds a changed path.
The `maxDiffLines` limit of an area at `auto-merge-eligible`.
The `maxUncoveredShare` limit of an area at `auto-merge-eligible`.
Changed paths that match no area.
The route of an entry of `review.route.paths` whose glob matches a changed path.
The `maxDiffLines` limit of a path entry at `auto-merge-eligible`.
The `maxUncoveredShare` limit of a path entry at `auto-merge-eligible`.
The score against `seniorScore`.
The score against `ownerScore`.
A change with no changed path takes the default route.
